name: Canopy Rope Bridges & Native Corridor Reforestation
description: Install arboreal rope bridges across linear roads and plant native Cullenia exarillata, Mesua ferrea, and Ficus saplings to bridge fragmented forest parcels.
problem_addressed: Severe arboreal fragmentation isolating Lion-tailed macaques and canopy frugivores.
feasibility_notes: Highly viable in collaboration with local tea estates and highway authorities; rapid adoption by arboreal species demonstrated in Western Ghats trials.

name: High-Canopy Pollinator Sanctuary & Pesticide Buffer
description: Establish pesticide-free buffer strips along plantation edges and propagate native flowering epiphytes and bee forage plants.
problem_addressed: Sharp decline in Apis dorsata bee colonies and Troides minos butterfly populations due to edge pesticide exposure.
feasibility_notes: Requires community organic stewardship agreements with adjacent estate managers and local tribal beekeepers.

name: Keystone Fig Propagation & Frugivore Nesting Cavity Protection
description: Protect mature veteran trees with nesting hollows and plant Ficus microcarpa cuttings to guarantee dry-season fruit availability.
problem_addressed: Scarcity of large nesting hollows for Great Hornbills and winter lean-season fruit shortages.
feasibility_notes: Low cost with high ecological leverage; community nest-guarding programs have proven track records in Anamalai hills.

name: Freshwater Flow Restoration & Sundari Tree Re-establishment
description: De-silt inland distributary creeks to augment freshwater inflows and reintroduce salt-stressed Heritiera fomes (Sundari) seedlings.
problem_addressed: Catastrophic top-dying disease and loss of structural Sundari mangrove forests due to hyper-salinization.
feasibility_notes: Requires hydrological desilting interventions and regional water-sharing consensus across upper delta barrages.

name: Rhizophora Stilt-Root Nursery & Coastal Bio-Shield Expansion
description: Propagate dense Rhizophora mucronata and Avicennia marina bio-shields along vulnerable intertidal embankments.
problem_addressed: Destruction of intertidal prop-root nurseries essential for juvenile tiger prawns, mud crabs, and storm surge absorption.
feasibility_notes: High local community participation through mangrove community nurseries; proven resilience against category 4 cyclones.

name: Sustainable Benthic Crab & Prawn Bycatch Mitigation Zones
description: Establish seasonal fishing holidays in core tidal channels and replace fine-mesh larval nets with eco-certified escape gap traps.
problem_addressed: Destructive wild tiger prawn seed collection depleting non-target benthic larvae and starving higher trophic predators.
feasibility_notes: Requires compensatory micro-grants for coastal fishers during breeding moratoria.
